title: Chat rules: thanks, long answer, filler, reactions

steps.note: AT-027: reaction-only terminal; the latest user row has 👍 or ❤️ and no assistant bubble/card follows it
AT-027: the terminal reaction is exactly an accepted thumbs-up or heart

steps.text: Tell me in about 200 words why people in India are switching to UPI, with a short list of 3 reasons

steps.expectJs: (()=>{const log=document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-log"]');if(!log)return false;const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('[data-side][data-gap]')];const me=rows.filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='me').at(-1);if(!me)return false;const start=rows.indexOf(me);const replies=rows.slice(start+1).filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='them').flatMap((r)=>[...r.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="bubble-foo"]')]);const lists=replies.filter((b)=>b.querySelector('ul,ol'));const filler=/great question|how can i help you|i apologize for the confusion/i;const suggestions=document.querySelector('[data-testid="composer-suggestions"]');const chips=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="composer-suggestion-chip"]')];return replies.length>=1&&replies.length<=3&&lists.length<=1&&!replies.some((b)=>filler.test(b.innerText||''))&&(!suggestions||(suggestions.dataset.kind==='followup'&&chips.length<=3));})()
steps.note: AT-030: at most 3 bubbles and any rendered list stays in one bubble; AT-031: no filler; AT-308: present chips are follow-ups from the reply and no more than 3
